policies.B1: A transit agency obtains standard operational authorization provided it holds a valid commercial transport licence.
policies.B2: A transit agency gains preferred carrier status if it holds standard operational authorization and manages an active fleet count of 10 vehicles or more.
policies.D1: A passenger carrier is assigned to premier summit transit duties provided it holds priority carrier recognition and maintains a passenger safety rating of at least 4.5 points.
policies.B3: A regional carrier satisfies emergency readiness criteria once it obtains an emergency response protocol certification.
policies.B4: A freight operator earns high-priority dispatch handling when demonstrating a quarterly on-time delivery rate of 90 percent or higher.

decoy_policies: A maritime shipping firm receives deepwater docking authorization provided it possesses a total cargo capacity of 50000 tons.
An aviation vendor earns flight corridor permission when logging zero safety infractions over a two year period.
